| **Nobu Los Angeles** | Beverly Hills | Celebrity‑famous, upscale setting with creative fusion rolls and impeccable service. |
| **KazuNori** | West Hollywood | Known for its high‑quality nigiri, generous portions, and a wide selection of rare fish. |
| **Sushi Park** | Koreatown | A hidden gem offering a quiet, intimate experience with meticulous attention to detail. |
| **Matsuhisa** | Downtown | Chef Nobu Matsuhisa’s flagship location, blending traditional techniques with modern flair. |
